main_measure.name: mean unusual 3-bar move of short cases (return minus coin's normal 3-bar drift, short direction)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day summed together

main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 with positive mean confirms; t <= -2 rejects; t clustered by day

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, larger-|forecast| half minus smaller half

decided_by: The main-measure t lies between -2 and 2. No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction -0.688 (below 1), 443 cases (30 needed).
reading: Cases are short bets (forecast rise of >= 2 points on the short side) taken at the first bet bar of each 3-bar grid cell per window, measured from that bar's close over 3 bars, over all coins in the record; the larger half is the top floor(n/2) cases by |forecast|; the plan's fewer-than-30-case-days rule is applied as the minimum count giving 'not observable'.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction -0.688 (below 1), 443 cases (30 needed)
